summary: Frontend-only testing of the Radhika Traders admin sidebar redesign (accordion groups, desktop sticky, mobile drawer). Admin desktop + mobile flows, employee login + navigation, and logout all validated via Playwright on the live preview URL. All admin-side requirements pass. One behavioral bug found on the employee sidebar: it is NOT flat — it still renders accordion group buttons for permissions-based items (Customers, Payments), contrary to the spec that employee/customer sidebars should be flat.

ui_bugs.issue: Employee sidebar renders 4 group buttons (side-group-*) instead of a flat list. Items with perms (leads/withdrawals/clients/reports) are grouped by `n.group` for the employee too. Spec requires flat sidebar for employee (and customer). Confirmed via query: 4 [data-testid^='side-group-'] on /employee for rahul.k.

issues: Group label 'Website & Settings' is truncated to 'Website & Setti…' due to the w-60 sidebar + icon + count badge + chevron taking too much width. Acceptable but visible truncation on 1440x900.

verified_behaviors: sidebar-nav present on /admin, side-dashboard link present
6 group buttons with correct item counts: Campaigns=3, Customers=4, Payments=2, Communication=2, Team & HR=4, Website & Settings=3
Clicking side-group-campaigns expands and shows side-campaigns, side-offer-banners, side-categories
Accordion: clicking side-group-customers expands Customers (aria=true) AND collapses Campaigns (aria=false)
Clicking side-leads-reports navigates to /admin/leads; Customers group remains open (aria=true); active link has bg-red-600 highlight
Direct navigation to /admin/attendance auto-opens Team & HR (aria=true) and highlights side-attendance-&-salary (bg-red-600)
Desktop sidebar height 852px <= viewport 900px (sticky top-6, h-[calc(100vh-3rem)]); internal scroll area present
Mobile (390x844): desktop aside display=none; dash-mobile-toggle visible
document.documentElement.scrollWidth == 390 (no horizontal overflow) with drawer closed and open
Body overflow set to 'hidden' when drawer open; restored to '' after close
Tap side-group-team-hr → side-employees in drawer: navigates to /admin/employees AND drawer auto-closes (translate-x-full)
dash-logout: present at bottom of desktop sidebar (visible) and inside mobile drawer; clicking in drawer logs out to /admin/login

Employee login (rahul.k/Emp@1234): flat links side-my-workspace, side-my-attendance, side-my-kyc visible and functional (navigation to /employee/attendance and /employee/kyc works on desktop and via mobile drawer)
action_items: Fix employee sidebar to be flat: in DashboardLayout.navForUser (or sections builder), strip `group` from entries when user.role === 'employee' so admin items visible to employees (leads/withdrawals/customers/kyc) render as flat LinkRows. Same for customer role.
critical_code_review_comments: navForUser only special-cases employee by prepending 'My Workspace' and filtering, but keeps `n.group` on admin entries → employee sees accordion groups. Flatten by mapping `({...n, group: undefined})` for non-admin roles.

LinkRow data-testid uses `label.toLowerCase().replace(/[\s/]+/g, '-')` so 'Attendance & Salary' becomes 'side-attendance-&-salary' (literal ampersand). Works but unusual; keep in mind if HTML-escaping/CSS selectors are ever used. Spec explicitly expects this id.
Group id uses `/[^a-z]+/g` → '-', which collapses & and space; works but strips any digits in future group names. Minor.
Desktop sidebar: 'Website & Settings' label truncates due to fixed w-60. Consider slightly larger width or shrink the count badge to avoid clipping.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (admin fully passes; employee flat-nav requirement failing)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All admin accordion/mobile drawer flows verified passing. Only remaining issue is employee (and presumably customer) sidebar flatness — fix in DashboardLayout.navForUser by discarding `group` when user.role !== 'admin'. After fix, re-verify no [data-testid^='side-group-'] exists in employee /employee page and all three flat links work on desktop + mobile drawer.
